decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The noise emitted from the air conditioning units hereby approved, should not be audible when assessed from the nearest noise sensitive receptor within the first floor residential flat at 286A Chiswick High Road.

Condition : 4 - The noise level emitted from the air conditioning units hereby approved should not at least 10dB(A) below the existing background noise levels (LAeq), when measured from the nearest noise sensitive receptor within the first floor residential flat at 286A Chiswick High Road over any 24 hour period.
description: Proposed installation of air conditioning units to rear elevation.
